info.prompt: A hacker's shrine of bone-circuitry and shattered stained glass, where dice float in anti-gravity fields above a hexagonal neural lattice, their cores burning with alternating amber and cyan—terminal text spirals upwards in corrupted Gothic script, merging with the pulsing 40Hz sub-bass that makes the player's cybernetic eye implant flicker wildly, the entire composition framed by vignetted darkness that creeps inward like liquid obsidian.
